scoring_justification: Binding energies are compared to paper's HSE06+vdW values with tolerance; recompute from raw DFT is infeasible in verifier sandbox. Tetramer structure is verified by geometric criteria (T3 structural audit).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold binding energies and pentamer energy difference from paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 4a and text: binding energy per water molecule for n=1..6 on CaO(001) (3x4) supercell at HSE06+vdW level, and 0.06 eV energy difference for orthogonal attachment.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values correspond exactly to the paper's quantified results.

outputs.description: Binding energy per water molecule (eV) for n=1 to 6 water molecules on a CaO(001) (3×4) supercell, including zero-point energy, and the energy difference (eV) between chain and orthogonal attachment for the pentamer. The values will be compared to the paper's reported results with appropriate tolerances.

schema.description: Standard XYZ file. First line: number of atoms. Second line: comment containing the unit cell parameters (e.g., Lattice="a b c alpha beta gamma"). Subsequent lines: element symbol followed by x, y, z coordinates (Angstrom). The structure must contain exactly one oxygen atom from a water species inside the distorted square of the tetramer and one such oxygen atom outside the square on an adjacent surface site.

outputs.description: Relaxed atomic coordinates of the water tetramer and surface atoms, verifying the extra hydroxyl positions.

output_contract.notes: All output files must be written under /app/outputs. The binding energies are scored by comparing each value to the paper's reported HSE06+vdW results (reference match); the tetramer structure is checked for the correct positions of the extra hydroxyl (structural audit).

steps.description: Verify one water-derived hydroxyl sits inside a square of Ca atoms and another outside on a surface site.
